verses.zh: （ 上 行 之 詩 。 ） 耶 和 華 啊 ， 我 從 深 處 向 你 求 告 ！
verses.en: A song of ascents.[NOTE:1] From the deep water[NOTE:2] I cry out to you, O Lord.
notes: Psalm 130. The psalmist, confident of the Lord’s forgiveness, cries out to the Lord for help in the midst of his suffering and urges Israel to do the same.

The precise significance of this title, which appears in Pss 120-134, is unclear. Perhaps worshipers recited these psalms when they ascended the road to Jerusalem to celebrate annual religious festivals. For a discussion of their background see L. C. Allen, Psalms 101-150 (WBC), 219-21.

verses.zh: 主 啊 ， 求 你 聽 我 的 聲 音 ！ 願 你 側 耳 聽 我 懇 求 的 聲 音 ！
verses.en: O Lord, listen to me.[NOTE:1] Pay attention to[NOTE:2] my plea for mercy.
notes: Heb “depths,” that is, deep waters (see Ps 69:2, 14; Isa 51:10), a metaphor for the life-threatening danger faced by the psalmist.

verses.zh: 主 ─ 耶 和 華 啊 ， 你 若 究 察 罪 孽 ， 誰 能 站 得 住 呢 ？
verses.en: If you, O Lord, were to keep track of[NOTE:1] sins,O Lord, who could stand before you?[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “may your ears be attentive to the voice of.”

verses.zh: 但 在 你 有 赦 免 之 恩 ， 要 叫 人 敬 畏 你 。
verses.en: But[NOTE:1] you are willing to forgive[NOTE:2] so that you might[NOTE:3] be honored.[NOTE:4]
notes: The words “before you” are supplied in the translation for clarification. The psalmist must be referring to standing before God’s judgment seat. The rhetorical question expects the answer, “No one.”

verses.zh: 我 等 候 耶 和 華 ， 我 的 心 等 候 ； 我 也 仰 望 他 的 話 。
verses.en: I rely on[NOTE:1] the Lord.I rely on him with my whole being;[NOTE:2] I wait for his assuring word.[NOTE:3]

verses.zh: 我 的 心 等 候 主 ， 勝 於 守 夜 的 ， 等 候 天 亮 ， 勝 於 守 夜 的 ， 等 候 天 亮 。
verses.en: I yearn for the Lord,[NOTE:1] more than watchmen do for the morning,yes, more than watchmen do for the morning.[NOTE:2]

verses.zh: 以 色 列 啊 ， 你 當 仰 望 耶 和 華 ！ 因 他 有 慈 愛 ， 有 豐 盛 的 救 恩 。
verses.en: O Israel, hope in the Lord,for the Lord exhibits loyal love[NOTE:1] and is more than willing to deliver.[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “more than watchmen for the morning, watchmen for the morning.” The words “yes, more” are supplied in the translation for stylistic reasons.
Heb “for with the Lord [is] loyal love.”

verses.zh: 他 必 救 贖 以 色 列 脫 離 一 切 的 罪 孽 。
verses.en: He will deliver[NOTE:1] Israelfrom all their sins.[NOTE:2]
